title: Scalar Quantity
content: A scalar quantity is a physical quantity that has only magnitude and is completely described by a single number with an appropriate unit.

title: Vector Quantity
content: A vector quantity is a physical quantity that has both magnitude and a directional quality.

title: Distance
content: Distance (or distance travelled by the body) is the length of the path along which the body moves.

title: Displacement
content: Displacement is the distance travelled along a particular direction, directed from the starting point to the end point.

title: Average Speed
content: The average speed is the ratio of total distance to time taken.

title: Average Velocity
content: The average velocity is the ratio of total displacement to time taken.

title: Instantaneous Speed
content: Instantaneous speed is defined as the time rate of change of distance.

title: Instantaneous Velocity
content: Instantaneous velocity is defined as the time rate of change of displacement.

title: Instantaneous Acceleration
content: Instantaneous acceleration is the time rate of change of velocity.
